fact: Loi n° 019/AN/23/9ème L (Code Numérique), published in the Journal Officiel on 2025-09-18, bars a controller or processor from transferring personal data to a third country or international organisation unless it ensures an equivalent and sufficient level of protection (art. 99), with exceptions such as consent, contract, public interest, legal claims or vital interests, or authorisation by the Commission nationale de protection des données (art. 102); the passages seen state no entry-into-force date, so the publication date is used.
system: Loi n° 019/AN/23/9ème L portant Code Numérique, Livre premier, art. 99-103

fact: Article 9 of Decree 2020-146/PR/MI, issued after the Council of Ministers of 7 July 2020 and published 13 July 2020, states that the processed data of the National Register of Natural Persons (RNPP) are stored only on national territory; the document gives the publication date and no separate entry-into-force date.
system: Decree 2020-146/PR/MI, Article 9 (RNPP data stored only on national territory)

fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Djibouti as having signed the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 12/05/2023, with no ratification or deposit date shown.
system: AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)

fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Djibouti had already ratified the African Union Malabo Convention in November 2023.
